name: Katanegai
source:
Upon learning of their parents' passing, the Minami siblings—Seia and Nagi—returned to their ancestral village.  
With few villagers remaining, they settled into a quiet life together...  
But when Nagi fell gravely ill, Seia sought help at the shrine—where he encountered a mysterious black-clad shrine maiden named Yami.  
To save his sister, Yami revealed that he must "unite" with Nagi.  
This is a tale of defiling wishes to fulfill the—all to save the one most precious to you.
translation:
得知父母去世的消息后，南兄妹——圣亚和凪——回到了他们祖传的村庄。
村民所剩无几，他们一起过着平静的生活……  
但当凪病重时，圣亚前往神社寻求帮助，在那里他遇到了一位名叫暗的神秘黑衣巫女。
为了拯救妹妹，亚美透露他必须与凪“团结”。
这是一个关于实现一切肮脏愿望的故事——一切都是为了拯救你最珍贵的人。
